title: Bounded interactive assistant and visible request recovery
steps: Inspect assistant UI and provider/key origin diagnostics
Bound interactive provider request time/retries and reject empty cached replies
Display inline loading/error/retry/cancel states with stale-job request protection
Expose credential origins and explicit service-key inheritance without changing workspace .env
Research official agent APIs, token/runtime pricing and current assisted browser visibility
Add browser/backend regression tests; verify and deploy
Confirm health and report any workspace credential action
constraints: Preserve user credentials and provider choices
Never return raw provider error bodies or credential values
Mock model calls for regression verification; any live diagnostic is explicit and bounded
No application submission or document regeneration
Agent integration recommendations only; no paid-provider switches
